sentences.text: We begin with start equal to zero.
At index zero, the value is one.
One plus minus one becomes zero.
Three plus zero is still three.
Now move start to index one.
Minus one plus two becomes one.
Finally, start index 6, reset the sum.
And now every possible starting position has been processed.
But look at the work we just did.
For start 0, we built many running sums.
Then for start 1, we again calculated sums over ranges that overlap the previous work.
Again, same array values, same overlapping ranges, but we keep rebuilding their sums.
That repeated work is the real problem.
Now let us write this method in code.
